liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Reviewer found Casey Jones electric, possibly the best Dead & Company version they have heard [8]
- **Standing on the Moon** (1 review): Bobby wept during Standing on the Moon, and the audience members did too, according to the reviewer [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Easy Wind**: back after 45 archived shows (386 days); rare: 14 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **deadco2024-06-21.Tire_Iron** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader warns the recording is very chatty, and says this was beyond their control [1]
- **deadco2024-06-21.dpa4080.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 178 min [2]
- **deadco2024-06-21.aud.jenkins.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 178 min [3]
- **deadco2024-06-21**: source not stated; 20 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Crowd 1st Set [1]
- Taped from Section 207, Row 12, Seat 4 [2]
- Reviewer says the second set holds the real magic of the night [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2024-06-21.Tire_Iron**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: Church Audio CA-14 (omni) Bat2b custom modification > Stereo Breakout > Rode AI Micro > iPhone 14 Pro via Apogee Meta Recorder [1]. Also: Transfer path: iPhone to Wav, then Reaper, then 24-bit FLAC, transferred by Eric Lugassy [1]
- **deadco2024-06-21.dpa4080.flac24**: taped by John Hermsen; transferred by John Hermsen; source: DPA 4080 > DPA MPS-6030 > Sony PCM A10 [2]. Also: Markus W. in Dusseldorf, Germany cleaned the recording using iZotope RX [2]
- **deadco2024-06-21.aud.jenkins.flac16**: taped by Tony Jenkins; transferred by richteratmosphere; source: AUD [3]. Also: Tony Jenkins made a mono audience recording using a Shure KSM27, Focusrite Scarlett 2i2, Reaper and a MacBook Pro, at 24-bit/192kHz; Processed with iZotope RX 4: volume balanced, resampled to 48kHz, dithered to 16 bit, then encoded to FLAC [3]
- **deadco2024-06-21**: taped by Bootsy Jacobs [4]
